title: Pan Fried Canadian Fish Hash
description: A crispy pan-fried Canadian fish dish with a crunchy hash topping. Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan with 1 tbsp of olive oil over medium heat.
Season the Canadian fish fillets with salt and pepper.
Add the fish fillets to the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until cooked through.
In a separate pan, heat the remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and bell pepper to the pan and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the shredded hash brown potatoes to the pan and cook until crispy, about 5 minutes.
To serve, place the cooked fish fillets on top of the hash brown potato mixture.
